reviewer: Codex retail_register_art (AI serializer self-review after independent root finding)

findings.scope: Evidence and media copies before registry write
findings.finding: A failed copy or final baseline check can leave partial retained evidence and/or the PNG. The next invocation rejects existing outputs, with no journal identifying ownership and no recovery route.

fs.writeFileSync truncates the live retail-pilot JSON before completing the new bytes. A write failure or interruption can leave a corrupt target; no staged replacement or raw preimage backup is retained by the serializer.

findings.scope: Provenance and receipt after registry write
findings.finding: A failure after the registry update but before provenance/receipt creation leaves a partially integrated state. Subsequent exact-baseline guards reject that state without an explicit rollback or recovery mechanism.

required_revision: Stage every output and raw preimage before production mutation
Persist a prepared journal with exact file hashes and ownership
Guarded multi-file install with rollback on thrown errors
Explicit recovery after interruption; never infer completion or automatically reapply
Preserve allowed pre-existing byte-identical immutable source/media files; reject differing bytes
Include exact PNG, retained evidence, one registry replacement, provenance, and integration receipt in the guarded commit
Verify exact resulting registry, audits, source/image/provenance hashes before marking committed
